high_level_description: The image shows a man standing indoors against a plain beige wall with the word "Dior" partially visible in large, light-colored letters. The man is dressed in a casual yet stylish outfit that combines elements of both formal and relaxed attire. He is wearing a light beige, button-up jacket over a light blue, long-sleeved shirt. The shirt is untucked, revealing a striped tie with red and gray diagonal stripes. His lower half consists of dark blue jeans that fit snugly around his thighs and hips, and he is wearing light blue sneakers with white soles.
